tagline: Standalone player with an on-device AI voice engine — music removed automatically
changelog: Large-file fix: songs are streamed straight into the audio engine instead of being decoded into memory, so long recordings no longer exhaust RAM and crash the app

New AI voice engine (AudioWorklet): adaptive spectral separation that learns each track while it plays — centre-channel coherence, pitch/harmonic tracking, syllabic modulation and live voice/music profiles
No music mode anywhere: the mode selector, stem mixer, music fader and karaoke/mix exports are gone — every song plays as pure voice
Live AI panel: voice activity, music-cut dB, tracked pitch, engine state and processing latency
Safer exports: the purified voice is recorded while the song plays and written to the WAV in chunks (plus a native finishWav header patch), so a two-hour file is as safe as a three-minute one
Streamed phone-library playback with HTTP range support in the Android host, so seeking works on huge files without copying them into JavaScript
Offline & private: 100% on-device processing; songs never leave your phone
